newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sydkraft up on hopes of higher power price.
newsitem.headline: Sydkraft up on hopes of higher power price.

text.p: Shares in Swedish power company Sydkraft AB rallied on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Tuesday on hopes of higher electricity prices after a political decision to start phasing out nuclear power.
"The shares are surging on higher electricity prices," said a trader with a Stockholm bank.
At 0945 GMT, the share was up six percent, or 8.5 crowns, at 148 crowns, while the exchange's general index was up 0.57 percent at 2,543.29.

Market players apparently did not think much of reports saying that the government will start the phase out by closing Sydkraft's nuclear power plant Barseback. Sydkraft has demanded compensation and has said it has legal support for its claims.
